data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 1225 reported an opening gross claims outstanding (claims reserves) of GBP 447.1m at 1 January 2016. During 2016 there was a favourable prior year movement (a release) of GBP 27.8m, attributed to favourable claims development, resulting in a reduction in the prior years' claims provision.
data.data_quality_notes: Scanned/photocopied images were used. Balance sheet claim outstanding amounts (447.1 as prior-year) were read from the liabilities section (page number printed as 9). Prior-year movement taken from Note titled 'Prior years' claims provision' / 'Favourable movement in technical provisions' (values 27.8 for 2016, 37.8 for 2015) on printed page ~20. The claims development triangle and detailed segmental premium mix were visible but not reliably machine-readable in these images, so triangle rows and detailed premium-class lines were not extracted. Where exact text was unclear, best-effort verbatim snippets were used. Users should verify against the original PDF for audit purposes.
